audience: online sellers and warehouse teams who manage orders and stock in Linnworks

useCases.title: Check the stock level and history of a SKU
useCases.text: Finds a product by SKU, title or barcode and shows its stock at each location, and the history of stock changes with date, new level and note.

useCases.title: List open orders waiting to be despatched
useCases.text: Lists the open orders of a fulfilment location with status, reference, source and received date, and reads full details of selected orders.

useCases.title: Find an order by number or channel reference
useCases.text: Finds an order, open or processed, by its Linnworks order number or by an Amazon or eBay reference, and shows its details and notes.

useCases.title: Search despatched orders
useCases.text: Searches processed orders by tracking number, customer name, email, postcode, SKU or source, optionally within a date range.

useCases.title: Set a product's stock level at a location
useCases.text: Reads the current level, then sets the stock of a product at one location to an exact quantity. The new level goes to the sales channels the item is listed on.

useCases.title: Read or add notes on an order
useCases.text: Reads the notes on an order, internal or external, and adds a new note. External notes may be passed to the sales channel.
